initialize.instructions: This is the Neo4j official MCP server and can provide tool calling to interact with your Neo4j database,by inferring the schema with tools like get-schema and executing arbitrary Cypher queries with read-cypher.

tools.description:
Retrieve the schema information from the Neo4j database, including node labels, relationship types, and property keys.
		If the database contains no data, no schema information is returned.
tools.name: get-schema

tools.description: read-cypher can run only read-only Cypher statements. For write operations (CREATE, MERGE, DELETE, SET, etc...), schema/admin commands, or PROFILE queries, use write-cypher instead.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the Cypher query

tools.name: read-cypher

tools.description: write-cypher executes any arbitrary Cypher query, with write access, against the user-configured Neo4j database.

params.description: Parameters to pass to the Cypher query

tools.name: write-cypher
